I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread to confirm I've noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal (the Moorland work) is on 7 July.

Nothing else needed doing. The workspace knowledge base saves channel messages automatically, and her message is already stored there with her name, the channel and the date. A renewal date is an account fact, not a money figure, so the finance-sharing rules don't apply.
